name: speedy-git-ext
description: A performance-first, lightweight Git graph visualization extension for VS Code

speedyGit.telemetry.enabled.markdownDescription: Allow Speedy Git to send anonymous usage statistics (feature usage counts, error codes, performance timings — never repository names, branch names, file paths, or anything you type). **Note:** anonymous usage statistics are sent only when this setting and VS Code's global `#telemetry.telemetryLevel#` setting are both enabled — turning either off stops all collection. See [telemetry details](https://github.com/onlineeric/speedy-git-ext#telemetry).

speedyGit.batchCommitSize.markdownDescription: Number of commits to load per batch in the Git graph panel. Lower values give faster initial load; higher values reduce scroll-triggered fetches for large repositories. Values above 10000 are capped.

enumDescriptions: Show the lightning icon followed by 'Speedy Git'.
speedyGit.statusBarText.markdownDescription: Label shown for the Speedy Git status bar item.

speedyGit.graphColors.markdownDescription: Array of hex color strings used for graph branch lines. Colors cycle in order.

enumDescriptions: Use the date-fns token string in `speedyGit.dateFormatCustom`
speedyGit.dateFormat.markdownDescription: Date display format for commit rows. Choose `custom` to provide your own [date-fns format tokens](https://date-fns.org/docs/format) in `#speedyGit.dateFormatCustom#`.

speedyGit.dateFormatCustom.markdownDescription: Custom date format using [date-fns tokens](https://date-fns.org/docs/format) (e.g. `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm`, `MMM d, yyyy`). Only used when `#speedyGit.dateFormat#` is set to `custom`. Falls back to `relative` if the token string is invalid or empty.

speedyGit.avatars.enabled.markdownDescription: Show author avatars in the commit graph. Initials are used when an avatar is unavailable.

speedyGit.avatars.refreshDays.markdownDescription: How long a looked-up avatar stays cached before it is refreshed in the background. Avatars are cached per author email and reused across repositories, so a longer window means far fewer GitHub API requests. A stale entry keeps displaying while it refreshes, and GitHub avatar image URLs are stable — so a longer window does not mean out-of-date pictures.

speedyGit.git.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Maximum time, in seconds, any git command Speedy Git runs may take before it is stopped. This covers everything: loading the graph, push, pull, fetch, commit hooks and the rest. Values below 15 are treated as 15. Set to `0` for no timeout; a command that stalls (a network hang, an unanswered credential prompt) then keeps running until you reload the window.

speedyGit.showRemoteBranches.markdownDescription: Show remote branch labels in the graph.

speedyGit.showTags.markdownDescription: Show tag labels in the graph.

speedyGit.overScan.markdownDescription: Number of commit rows to render above and below the visible graph viewport. Higher values reduce blank-row flicker during fast scrolling at the cost of more DOM nodes. Lower values use less memory but may show empty rows when scrolling quickly.

speedyGit.toolbar.showLabels.markdownDescription: Show a small text label under each toolbar icon button (Filter, Search, Compare, Worktrees, Refresh, Fetch, View, Remote, Settings, News, Help). You can also toggle this by right-clicking any toolbar button.

speedyGit.toolbar.showRemoteButton.markdownDescription: Show the Remote (Manage Remotes) button in the toolbar. You can also toggle this by right-clicking the View, Remote, or Settings toolbar button.

speedyGit.autolinks.remoteProvider.enabl.markdownDescription: Turn issue and pull request references in commit messages into links to the repository's GitHub or GitLab page: `#123` and `GH-123` on GitHub, `#123` (issue) and `!123` (merge request) on GitLab, and `owner/repo#123` on either. Links are added only when the remote is on `github.com` or `gitlab.com`: the remote is the only one, or `upstream`, or else `origin`. Any other host gets no links, so a link never points somewhere it might be wrong.

prefix.markdownDescription: Text that comes before the number, e.g. `ABCD-`. A prefix with a space goes in double quotes: `"Jira "` links `Jira 123`. Inside the quotes, `\"` is a literal double quote.

url.markdownDescription: Link to open, with `<num>` where the number goes, e.g. `https://jira.example.com/browse/ABCD-<num>`. Must be an `http://` or `https://` URL.

ignoreCase.markdownDescription: Match the prefix in any letter case, so `Jira-` also links `JIRA-123`. On unless set to `false`.

alphanumeric.markdownDescription: Match letters and digits after the prefix, not only digits.

speedyGit.autolinks.custom.markdownDescription: Turn ticket references in commit messages into links, e.g. Jira keys like `ABCD-123`. Each entry is a `prefix` and a `url` with `<num>` where the number goes. The format matches GitLens's `gitlens.autolinks`, so an existing GitLens list can be copied in. You can also edit this list from the graph's **View** settings.

speedyGit.worktree.basePath.markdownDescription: Parent directory where new git worktrees are created. The sanitized ref name is appended below it as the worktree folder — either nested or flattened, per `#speedyGit.worktree.folderNameStyle#` (e.g. `../myrepo.worktrees/feat/foo` or `../myrepo.worktrees/feat-foo`). Supports the `${repoName}` token. Defaults to a sibling folder so worktrees stay outside the watched working tree (protects graph performance).

enumDescriptions: Keep the branch hierarchy as folders: branch `feat/x` becomes `feat/x`.
Flatten the branch hierarchy into one folder name: branch `feat/x` becomes `feat-x`.
speedyGit.worktree.folderNameStyle.markdownDescription: Which worktree folder is preselected in the Create Worktree dialog for a branch name containing `/`. Both options are always offered in the dialog; this only chooses the default.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:ext && pnpm run build:webview
scripts.build:prod: pnpm run build:ext:prod && pnpm run build:webview
scripts.ext:publish: pnpm run ext:publish:vscode && pnpm run ext:publish:cursor
